question: Where is the nearest restaurant you encounter heading toward Green rooftop garden at design building, Amherst, MA from Bidwell House Museum, Monterey, MA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.218371 42.208433)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.523498 42.388204)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.218371 42.208433)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.218371 42.208433)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
